choices.label: Heart attack or blocked arteries
choices.examples: stent, bypass surgery, angina (chest pain from the heart)
choices.condition: Heart attack or coronary artery disease

choices.label: Very high cholesterol
choices.examples: familial hypercholesterolemia, cholesterol treated from a young age

choices.label: A diagnosed inherited rhythm condition
choices.examples: long QT syndrome, Brugada syndrome, CPVT
choices.condition: Inherited rhythm condition (long QT, Brugada, CPVT)

choices.label: Unexplained fainting
choices.examples: passed out without warning, or while exercising

choices.label: Survived a cardiac arrest, or has an implanted defibrillator
choices.examples: heart stopped and was restarted with CPR or a shock, has an ICD
choices.condition: Survived cardiac arrest or has an ICD

choices.label: Sudden or unexplained death
choices.examples: died suddenly or in their sleep, unexplained drowning or car crash, died after collapsing during exercise

choices.label: Heart muscle disease
choices.examples: cardiomyopathy, thick or enlarged heart, heart failure at a young age

choices.label: Aortic aneurysm or tear
choices.examples: aortic aneurysm, aortic dissection (a tear in the aorta)
